subject.title: feat(grok): handle ask_user_question and exit_plan_mode client extensions

question: Should acpx adopt these Grok-specific extension handlers and exported callbacks as supported core interoperability surface, rather than leaving Grok Build to an external adapter or wrapper?
rationale: The branch adds named, vendor-specific methods and public callback conventions; the vision supports interoperability but explicitly asks maintainers to scrutinize new conventions and avoid an unbounded set of harness-specific special cases.

options.title: Sponsor narrow core support
options.body: Accept the two verified methods as a bounded ACP compatibility layer after documentation synchronization and real Grok runtime proof.

options.title: Keep Grok behavior external
options.body: Decline new core callbacks and direct the integration toward an adapter or wrapper until a more general extension model is defined.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow core support
recommendation.body: Accept the two verified methods as a bounded ACP compatibility layer after documentation synchronization and real Grok runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision concerns the long-lived acpx public API and compatibility direction.
